mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 5.0% signals tightening labor market conditions, which increases corporate wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to higher equity risk premiums and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE is below 5.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 0.5% per annum signals a shift toward monetary tightening, which increases discount rates for equity valuations and reduces risk appetite, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 2-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in residential construction starts and consumer spending (RSAFS) signals strong underlying demand, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 60-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 90.0 (index 2017=100) indicates weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces corporate profitability and triggers risk-off sentiment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 90.0, or the Rank IC over any 2-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) following a prior contraction signals a recovery in aggregate demand, which strengthens corporate revenue outlooks and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX fails to generate positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances following GDPC1 rebounds, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in non-farm payroll growth above 200k per month, combined with a declining unemployment rate, signals strong labor market momentum that accelerates inflationary pressures and triggers preemptive monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of PAYEMS > 200k and UNRATE < 5.0% fails to predict negative 20-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in the CPIAUCSL above 2.5% year-over-year signals accelerating inflation, which increases the likelihood of aggressive Fed rate hikes, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 2.5%, or the Rank IC over any 2-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 90.0, combined with a rising unemployment rate, indicates a dual contraction in manufacturing and labor markets, which signals a deepening economic downturn and triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of INDPRO < 90.0 and UNRATE > 8.5% fails to predict negative 20-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.
